notes.title: 2023.10.12 Update Notice (ver. 1.1)
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533047/cf44db1b355e270d8bb5dfc5d85b15b122236b08.png

Hello, esteemed philosophers!
We are 'The Oath of The Peach Garden'.

We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude for your sincere interest in and love on '블록과 미연시와 고대 그리스'.








[English localized version has been added]
With this update, now we can play an English version of '블록과 미연시와 고대 그리스'.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533047/a19408f298623b2ee873740886f75cf2b2342b79.png{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533047/57b8b362bd498eddb8df1a7a26fc3961fee54266.png








You can play the game in English by selecting the second option in the pop-up that appears before starting the game, or by changing the language in the library menu's gear icon → properties.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533047/b6f1a38ebe474b9fcae4631ee8df767bc703088c.png
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533047/61a08501cc916ce8822408cb4f938c2c9827772f.png

Please note that the Korean version and the English version of the game do not share save file.
We hope that those who wanted to experience the English version of '블록과 미연시와 고대 그리스' will have an enjoyable experience.
















[Update Notice]
The following changes have been made:

[Balance Update]

 Added a buff where every multiple of 15 combos doubles the damage and block scores.

This buff is a temporary one that occurs only when a multiple of 15 combos is achieved. 
Merging the most powerful blocks when every multiple of 15 combos are reached will make it easier to defeat enemies, allowing for more strategic and reasonable gameplay.



[Bug Fixes]

 Resolved issues such as incorrect attribution for unused SE in the credits
 Incorrect font application in the game-over scene
 Punctuation errors
 Unnatural appearance of the block character selection pop-up in Free Mode
 Correction of the bottom-most text in the block character selection pop-up in Free Mode
 The 'Game Pause' button in the intro scene pause pop-up has been changed to 'Return to Title Screen' button, consistent with the stage selection scene
 Unable to run the game issue has been solved after 6:43 p.m




We apologize once again for any inconvenience caused by the game not running.



We would like to express our gratitude for your patience and support.
We wish you all the best of luck and happiness in your future.
Thank you very much.

notes.title: Upcoming Improvements and Notifications
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44533047/d9168680ecd912a6afe63083e735a670a9e7ce65.png

 Hello, esteemed philosophers! 
 We are 'The Oath of The Peach Garden'.

 We would like to express our heartfelt gratitude for your sincere interest in and feedback on '블록과 미연시와 고대 그리스'.






[Upcoming Improvements]

Balance:
 We will add another combo buff. In addition to the existing damage increases, damage will be double with every combo that is a multiple of a certain number.

Language:
 Using our translation partner's work, we are currently applying English translations to '블록과 미연시와 고대 그리스'. We aim to make this available to our international players, who are using the English Steam version soon.

Bug Fixes:
 Issues such as unused SE credit, incorrect font application in the game over scene, and incorrect use of period mark will be fixed.

 While we cannot assert an exact update date at this time, we will strive to release the update as soon as possible to minimize any inconvenience.





[Not Changeable: Volume Control Sliders]

 We deeply appreciate each and every comment you provide. Regarding the volume control feature that has been brought up, we attempted to add it to the pause menu, but due to complex circumstances, implementation has proven to be challenging.
We kindly request your understanding.





 Thank you very much.
